triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: withdrawn is a real terminal checklist status with decisionRef; a direct status=withdrawn write is refused
every done consumer treats withdrawn as terminal-not-delivered and renders WITHDRAWN
the scope-shrinkage decision carries decisionId/withdrawnChecklistItemRefs/withdrawnAcceptanceBindingRefs/evidenceRefs and legacy decisions still load
an append-only binding withdrawal is readable via proofstory_contract_get from DEV/REVIEW while the original binding is preserved
withdrawal authority and cross-layer consistency (incl. layer independence) hold on both the Zod and internal-call paths
withdrawing all core bindings is refused at write time unless explicitly re-approved (empty-scope floor), independent of doneGateMode
a smoke proves both directions of the recorded acceptance under lattice validate

note: One acceptance binding per checklist item, mapping the withdrawn-disposition acceptance claim to its verificationIntent refs. Layer 2 (bindingDispositions) will later be able to withdraw any of these append-only without editing them.
